messages.subject: Project Forge — engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace,

Following our call, please find attached our engagement letter for the CMA review (we've given it the internal codename Project Forge). It sets out scope, team, fee estimate and our standard terms. If you're happy, please sign and return the acknowledgement on the last page.

We'll send a draft response to the CMA's initial enquiry letter shortly.

Best
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0512
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
